Full firmware update · USB / UART

Update bootloader, partition table, Recovery and Flight as one release. NVS is backed up first and preserved on the board. The updater reads back every written image before reporting completion.

Terminal commands: sys recovery or ENTER_OTA + Enter. Build a release with make firmware-bundle. Full updates also work without a browser: make update-full FILE=firmware-full.zip PORT=/dev/ttyACM0.

  1. Select a complete release ZIP and the attached port.
  2. Prepare: close the dashboard serial connection, validate the release, read NVS and save a verified backup.
  3. Download the backup, then confirm the full update. Keep power connected.

The NVS backup contains saved parameters, calibration and Wi-Fi credentials. Keep it private. Flashing Recovery/bootloader can require ROM USB/UART repair if power fails.

Checking local updater…

Full update boots into Recovery after a manual reset. Use BOOT_MAIN to start Flight. A verified write does not yet confirm that Flight runs correctly. GPIO2 held low through reset for 3 seconds selects Recovery; GPIO9 BOOT + reset enters ROM download for USB/UART repair.
